div.div: Peak. 30 lookups a minute, 0.5 a second, 0.1 copies running on average. With 5 reserved copies a buyer meets a refusal about once in ten million lookups. The ceiling is 25 a second, about 50 times the peak

div.div: Bulk reads. Codes of 60 random bits. A month of guesses at the ceiling finds about 0.0002 valid codes, and each hit shows one buyer view with no personal data
